risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection risks
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions the 'Cybersecurity' section in Item 1C, indicating strategic importance. For a company managing $59.3 trillion in assets, cyberattack risks are inherently high. This risk is stable compared to prior years.

risks.title: Risks related to property management and real estate costs
risks.score_rationale: Item 2 details property management and notes that costs related to reducing or occupying new space may be material to operating results. However, this risk is secondary compared to major operational and regulatory risks. The risk is stable.

risks.title: Risks related to litigation and legal proceedings
risks.score_rationale: Item 3 refers to potential litigation disclosed in Note 21. For a financial services firm of this scale, litigation is inherent but managed through appropriate accounting provisions. The risk is stable.

risks.title: Risks related to financial markets and volatility
risks.score_rationale: Item 7A addresses market risk disclosures. As a major player in custody and asset management services, BNY is exposed to market volatility and fluctuations in fee revenue. The risk is stable.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: As a global financial institution operating across multiple jurisdictions (U.S., EMEA, APAC), BNY is subject to a complex and evolving regulatory environment including Dodd-Frank, MiFID II, GDPR, and local banking regulations. The costly adherence to these requirements is a permanent component of the operating model. The risk is stable.

risks.title: Technology and innovation dependency risks
risks.score_rationale: As a technology-based financial services platform, the ability to innovate in cloud, fintech, blockchain, and data processing is critical to maintaining competitiveness and servicing $59.3 trillion in assets. Technological obsolescence represents an existential risk. The risk is stable.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence in its 10-K/20-F report.
